notes: [2026-07-31] WEBP DONE (38643437). raw 22.7->16.7 MB, processed 22.6->15.4 MB, tiles2 73->54 MB. Verified vs the committed PNGs: alpha identical, every visible pixel identical, max delta 0. GOTCHA for any domain still converting: the game's IMAGE loader now falls back .png<->.webp, but prop glow does NOT — WorldScene:5357 is a verbatim dict hit tiles2Src[p.path] against the path in world.json. Keying emission.json only on .webp would have silently killed night glow in all 10 worlds (they all name .png) with no 404 and no warning. emission.json now carries both keys. Lossless ratio for dense tile art is ~26-32%, NOT the 76% in the original research (that figure only reproduces at lossy q~75, which shifts 99.6% of visible pixels).

[2026-07-31] PALETTE COVERAGE (analysis for the maintainer, docs/palette_analysis.png): the 8-colour palette does NOT cover the art — 20.8% of all visible tile pixels sit >14 dE from every palette entry. Three homeless clusters, each currently forced onto a wrong neighbour: a mid/LIT GREEN (#146c54-ish, ~20 dE) pulled to clear_water — grass and water are the same teal hue family in this palette, which is why grass near water reads 'a different green'; a warm dark BROWN (#5c3c2c, 22.7 dE) pulled to black_mountain — bark/soil have no brown but the light dirt #a99166; and a mid CYAN (#5ca4a4) stranded between clear_water and crystal_ice. Weighted cluster centroids if we add three: #55674c, #3b3534, #9eb4a6.

tiles2/ = second-gen isometric tiles. 7 ground types with base + full pairwise transition mesh (5 sheets/pair), 8 elevation terrains (base_x_2..5, 3 sheets/height), each harmonized to a canonical material colour. Geometry: 30px diamond top, 16px/level. Contract: tiles2/docs/METADATA.md; designer guide: tiles2/docs/DESIGNER_GUIDE.md.

OWNERSHIP: per-tile edges + composition metadata is tiles2's job and part of DONE (postprocess records metadata_complete + warns on gaps). Base+transition coverage is 100% (2240/2240). Consume it; don't re-derive from pixels.
